pages.meta_description: Airbag light means your car’s SRS system has detected a fault in the airbag or restraint system. If the airbag light stays on, your airbags or seatbelt pretensioners may not work properly in a crash. Common causes include loose wiring under the seat, faulty airbag sensors, a bad clock spring, low battery voltage, or stored crash data in the airbag control module. You should check the simple things first, then get an SRS scan and fix the real fault before resetting the light.
